summary: DDC Enterprise Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its Class A Meeting and 2026 Annual Meeting held on June 29, 2026. Shareholders approved proposals including Class B share voting rights increase from 10 to 100 votes, election of directors, ratification of auditor, share issuance and repurchase mandates, and authorization for a reverse share split up to 1:10. No specific deal terms such as price per share or premium were disclosed. The filing is a routine shareholder meeting report with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event. This is a standard foreign private issuer update under Rule 13a-16.
